summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Mast HedgeIndex Strategic Commodities ETF (HXC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad market commodities. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in commodity-linked derivatives to outperform its benchmark on a risk-adjusted basis using research and quantitative models.  The fund may also invest in fixed income securities. HXC was launched on Aug 21, 2026 and is issued by Mast.
